question: T10: written and pushed before reading CAP-T10FOLD5 and CAP-T10FOLD6. What folding does beside a fold, and what folds in each Mode.

beside.chevron then a key: the key lands: the press doesn't take focus away
beside.click right of the fold, key: `# a…Z`: text after the hidden lines, on the fold's own row
beside.one right, key: `# a…Z`: a fold is one stop for the arrow keys
beside.enter before the fold: row 1 `# a`, row 2 holds the fold
beside.delete before the fold: the hidden lines go, `# a` stays, row 2 `# d`
beside.backspace after the fold: the hidden lines go, as above
beside.backspace on the next line: `# a…# d`: the fold stays, the next line joins it
beside.up from below, key: the key lands on the fold's row
beside.selection over a fold deleted: the hidden lines go with it
beside.quote over a fold: every line under the selection gets `> `, hidden ones too
beside.key below a fold: fold kept, and Meta+z keeps it
beside.view with new text: no fold in the view, and its own fold on closing doesn't reach the panel: the panel's fold stays when the text starts the same

markdown.a heading: folds to the last thing before the next heading of its level or higher: blank lines there stay shown
markdown.a setext heading:
folds the same way as `#`: `a

markdown.setext stops atx: `# a` with a level 1 setext under it has no chevron
markdown.a list: each item with more than one line has one, a nested item too
markdown.a quote: one on its first line; a paragraph of several lines further in has its own
markdown.a rule, a link definition: `---` none; a link definition `[a]: b` none, and `c\nd` under it one

modes.css: `a {…}`, the `}` stays beside the placeholder and whatever follows it; a comment of several lines folds too
modes.javascript: `function f() {…};`, `[…]` inside, a comment of several lines, `if (x) {…} else {`

modes.plain: no chevrons; a fold doesn't survive changing Mode

second.backspace right of a fold: takes the last hidden letter and opens the fold
second.left from right of a fold: goes in and opens the fold, as right does from the other side
second.folding with the caret on a hidden line: caret stays, a key opens nothing until it lands
second.javascript: `function f() {…};`, `  return […];`, `const o = {…};` with ` a: 1 ` hidden, `/*…*/`, `if (x) {…} else {`, `} else {…}`
